title: Glazing Scheduling Software | Plan Fitters, Runs and Routes | Coglass
description: Glazing scheduling software: customers pick the times that suit them, Coglass groups nearby jobs into runs, and bookings go straight to your fitters’ phones.
lead: Drag jobs onto your team and vans, let customers tick the times that suit them, and let Coglass group nearby jobs into runs. Holidays block the board and bookings go straight to the fitters’ phones — without ten phone calls.
steps_h2: Your whole team's week, planned in minutes
steps_sub: The Coglass planning board gives managers a full view of who is doing what, when — and pushes the schedule straight to everyone's phones.
inc_h2: Team management tools built for glazing companies
inc_sub: From scheduling fitters to tracking holidays — everything you need to manage a field team.
steps: The scheduling view shows your full team in rows and upcoming dates in columns. At a glance you can see who's free, who's booked, and which days have gaps — for the week or the next two weeks.

Drag an order onto a team member's slot for a specific date. Set the visit type (survey, fitting, delivery), start time and duration. The assignment appears in that person's mobile app immediately — no call needed.
Put a van with each team member for each day from the same board.
Record holidays, sick days and training in the absence calendar. Absent team members show as blocked on the planning board — you can't accidentally book them in on a day they're off.
Team see their schedule on their phone
Bookings show in the field team's app — customer, address, visit type and time — without a call from the office.

The Map view shows the day’s stops and where clocked-in staff are. When a fitter arrives or leaves, the booking shows how long they have been on site — and Print all gives every team its run sheet for the day.
included: Visual planning board
Drag-and-drop schedule with all staff in one view. See the full week or two-week outlook at a glance.
Job assignment with time slots
Assign any order to any team member with specific start time and duration — survey, fitting or delivery.
On their phone
Bookings show in the team member's app, with a push notification when today's plan changes.
Customer availability link
Customers tick the arrival windows that suit them on a page in your branding. Send it by hand or automatically.
Map view and run sheets
See the day’s stops on a map, and print every team’s run sheet for the day.
Vehicle allocation
Assign a vehicle to each team member per day from the planning board.
Holiday and absence management
Record holidays, sick days and training. Absences block the planner so you can't double-book unavailable staff.
Holiday chart
Visual overview of all staff absences for the coming weeks — plan your resourcing before gaps appear.
Employee management
Store staff details, roles, employee types, contact info and mobile app access in one place.
Cards & certificates
Keep CSCS and other safety cards for each person — checked when you build a RAMS for a job.
Roles and permissions
Control who can see and do what. Starts with owner, office manager, estimator, surveyor, fitter and shop-floor roles, each adjustable.
Nearby jobs
When you book someone, Coglass lists other ready jobs a short drive from their stops that day, with the extra minutes for each.
Assignment notes
Add notes to any slot — special access instructions, customer preferences, equipment needed.
Seat licence management
See desktop and mobile user counts versus your plan limits — manage who has access without overpaying.
Suggested runs
Ready jobs that are close together grouped into runs, on the days customers said suit them.

stories.label: Smart scheduling
stories.h2: Fill the van without ringing round
stories.sub: Most planning time goes on phone calls to find a day that suits, then on driving across town between jobs. These tools cut both.

items.title: Customers pick the times that suit them
items.problem: You ring to book a fitting, the customer is at work, you leave a message, and they ring back when you are up a ladder.
items.fix: Press Request availability on the order — or let Coglass send it by itself when the job is ready for fitting. The customer gets an email link, taps every arrival window that suits and presses Send my times.
see: A “When are you free?” page with your logo and the arrival windows you choose, such as 8–10 and 9–11
A notification when they reply, and their times on the order
Jobs still waiting for a reply listed on their own, so you know who to phone

items.title: Suggested runs
items.problem: Ready jobs are spread across the area, and working out which ones go together on which day takes an evening with a map.
items.fix: Suggested runs looks at every survey and fitting not yet booked, groups the jobs that are close together, and picks the best day for each group from the times customers said suit them.
see: Runs by area for the next 7, 14 or 30 days, with the total hours and how many customers are free that day
A week view, and a grid of every job against every day with a tick where the customer is free
Schedule this run: pick the fitter, check the date, and the jobs go on the planner

items.title: Nearby jobs
items.problem: A fitter has a job across town in the morning and nothing after — and there is probably another ready job five minutes away that nobody thought of.
items.fix: Drop a job on someone’s day, or press the pin on their row, and Coglass lists other ready jobs only a short drive out of their way. It uses real driving time between the stops already booked, not distance on a map.
see: Each job with the extra driving it adds, such as “+8 min”, grouped as Close, Short detour or Further
Surveys, fittings and deliveries all offered
Tick the ones you want and add them to the day — they go into the first free gaps, and nothing already booked moves

items.title: Anytime customers
items.problem: Schools, surgeries, offices and trade counters are open all day. Asking them to pick a time just slows the booking down.
items.fix: Switch on Flexible scheduling for the customer. Coglass stops sending them the availability email and treats them as free 8am to 6pm every day, so their jobs fit into any run.
see: An Anytime label on their jobs in Nearby jobs, whatever day you are planning
An override on a single order when one site is different

items.title: Glass that won’t be in on time
items.problem: A fitting is booked for Tuesday, and on Monday you find the glass isn’t due until Thursday.
items.fix: The planner checks each booking against the job’s purchase orders.
see: The booking card turns hatched red when its glass won’t arrive in time
Chase PO from the booking’s job card
